claims.claim: Strong Inference uses a portable orchestration control plane plus bounded specialist research modules rather than one undifferentiated prompt.
Strong Inference uses functional public module names while technical IDs and slash-command aliases remain unchanged for compatibility.
Strong Inference Systems is presented as a working pre-product identity rather than as a legally cleared corporate, trademark, or domain name.

The product name Strong Inference intentionally refers to the established scientific-method concept of competing hypotheses and discriminating experiments; the repository does not claim the phrase as a newly invented scientific concept.

Adapt uses the stable foil technical namespace to model competing explanations for observed performance and supply task-relevant complementary methods without treating a single error as a stable weakness.
Human authority governs voluntary goals and actions while evidence and proof determine factual warrant.
Strong Inference contains ten public research-method modules.
Mechanical and specification validation do not establish behavioral efficacy of the complete system.
Assure uses the stable infinity-gauntlet technical namespace and does not require private project hooks or hard-coded local runtime paths; missing optional machinery is treated as unavailable.
Strong Inference is presented as a free MIT-licensed pre-product research-software preview rather than a hosted commercial service.
The repository provides machine-readable citation metadata and an MIT open-source license.
The public surfaces expose documented mechanical validation commands and separate their interpretation from behavioral-efficacy claims.
